purpose: Freeze the full AFK characteristic-to-flat-monoid label derivation for the d=12,f=3 overlap pilot before producing label results.

universe.characteristics: all p in (Z/12Z)^2, lexicographically ordered by (p1,p2)
universe.residue_sign_representative: (-p1-14*p2, p2, +1) modulo 12, modulo the frozen global-unit action

acceptance_checks: Q has fundamental discriminant 13 and conductor 3, hence is admissible for the frozen d=12 triple.
The stated stabilizer fixes beta and acts on every characteristic modulo 12.
Each stabilizer orbit has one and only one flat-monoid label under the formula.
The zero characteristic maps to the monoid zero class.
claim_boundary: A passing label map only identifies AFK characteristics with flat-monoid classes. It does not evaluate partial zeta values, establish radical annihilation, identify a packet, or prove TCC.
